correctness.rationale: The first jet exact sequence on P1×P1 gives c2(J1(O(a,b)))=c2(X)+2K_X.L+3L²=4-4a-4b+6ab, positive for all a,b>=1, hence a hypersurface dual of that degree. The primal degree is 2ab. Exact subtraction gives 4(a-1)(b-1) and 4(√b-√a)². At fixed D=ab, Δ=6D+4-4(a+D/a), where a+D/a strictly decreases for 1<=a<=√D, proving unique extremizers among divisors including D=1. Independent exact scan of D<=300 reproduces bounds and uniqueness. No finite scan is used as the universal proof.
